content: Weight management should be a fundamental component of the treatment plan for individuals with type 2 diabetes who are classified as overweight or obese. Clinical evidence indicates that even a modest reduction in body weight, approximately 3-7% of total body weight, can result in significant improvements in blood glucose levels. This improvement contributes to more effective management of diabetes. Furthermore, achieving moderate weight loss can decrease the reliance on glucose-lowering medications, enhance the body’s sensitivity to insulin, and, in some cases, potentially lead to sustained remission of diabetes.
